bio: Agata was baptized on 22 July 1777, daughter of Michele Moraca and Anna Maria Putero ([R4-S1]). She married Nicola Ferlaino in 1801 ([R4-S2]) and died on 26 November 1837 ([R4-S3]). The civil death act names her mother as Teresa Adamo, but the baptism names Anna Maria Putero. Death informants often guessed, so the baptism is preferred. Her brother Alessio Moraca (b. 1772, same parents) is also John's ancestor, through Carmela Moraca and the Colosimo line, so Michele Moraca and Anna Maria Puteri appear twice in John's tree.
